name: Runner Tests Fixture - Page Trigger Metadata
brief: Issue #3447: NCLMetaForm's twelve Is<Trigger>Defined flags must answer true exactly when the page - or, for the nine BC counts, a pageextension over it - declares the trigger.
description: Runner-mechanism fixture. The flags are page METADATA, not an AL surface: BC's own consumers of them sit on dispatch paths the runner serves itself, so there is nothing a corpus test could observe. The runner prints what it computed under AL_RUNNER_PAGE_TRIGGER_AUDIT=1 and PageTriggerMetadataTests asserts the exact set per page. Declares no application floor: everything it needs is its own.
